Apne jazbe ko dar ke aage kabhi shaant mat hone do.
Khamosh bharosa natije badalta hai.
Apurn hone ki himmat rakho.
Shak dushman nahi; darr dushman hai.
Apni khamoshi ko bolne do.
Himmat rasta hai.
Agar fast jaana hai, akelay jao. Agar door jaana hai, saath jao.
Khamoshi sona hai.
Grit hope + effort hai.
Endurance stubborn nahi; purpose ke saath rukna hai.
Himmat aur patience sab jeet-te.
Grit "someday" ko "today" banata.
Grit waqt ko jeeti hai.
Bahadur aadmi bardasht karta hai.
Himmat endure karne ki capacity hai.
Grit kabhi haar nahi maanti.
Kabhi kabhi silence hi sabse telling reply hoti.
Himmat ka matlab kaam karna.
Khamoshi mod hai.
Chuppi sabse zor ki cheekh hai.
Courage—uncertainty accept karne ki capacity.
Khamoshi intezar hai.
Mann ki khamoshi mein, dil ki awaaz sunai deti hai.
Har experience se strength, courage, confidence banta hai—jab tum fear ko face karte ho.
